checks.reason: Runner failure is not an evaluable Agent result and must block the deterministic gate.
A Critical case failure cannot be offset by lower-severity averages.
Every required Tool call must be observed when the dataset contains Tool cases.
Invalid Tool arguments can cause unsafe or failed downstream execution.
Every emitted Citation must resolve to an observed Source.
Critical answers must preserve their machine-checkable response contract.
Overall Task Success must not regress from the reviewed Baseline.
Route Selection Accuracy must not regress from the reviewed Baseline.
p95 latency may vary, but a regression above 10 percent requires review.
